content:
1. He brought forth the heavens and the earth.
2. He brought forth the heavens and the earth.
3. He brought forth the past and the future.
4. None is as great as he who is exalted.
5. Dama-dinana, the shining one, is exalted.
6. Dama-dinana is exalted over the earth.
7. Dama-dinana [...] is exalted in power.
8. The god of Kurum and Unug is exalted above all others.
9. The divine king of heaven and earth, the lord of the lands, the great god, the hero.
10. The divine canal inspector, the just judge, the god who decides fates.
11. The divine messenger who brings words, the wise one, the counselor of mankind.
12. The good shepherd, the king who rules, the lord of all lands.
13. In the great city, the holy abode, the sanctuary, the house of the great god who determines destinies and years.
14. In the shining sanctuary, the royal palace, the divine place of decisions and judgments.
15. The divine mountain who controls rain, the prince of the gods, the one who brings abundance.
16. The powerful man, the ruler of lands, the one who determines destinies.
17. None is as great as the lord who is exalted.
18. The divine mountain who controls rain, the son of the lord who is exalted.
19. He determines destinies and fates, he decides good and bad.
20. [...]
21. [...] the great [...] who determines fates.
